questions.context: En una clase de inglés en Manizales, los niños dibujan a la persona que los cuida en casa: su mamá.

options.feedback: Correct. "Mother" is the word for mom, the woman who is your parent.
Incorrect. "Father" means dad, the man who is your parent, not your mom.
Incorrect. "Brother" is a boy who has the same parents as you, not your mom.
Incorrect. "Baby" is a very young child in the family, so it cannot be your mom.

questions.explanation: La palabra "mother" significa mamá o madre. "Mom" es la forma corta y cariñosa de decir "mother". Las otras palabras nombran a otros miembros de la familia: "father" (papá), "brother" (hermano) y "baby" (bebé).
questions.subject: ingles

questions.statement: Complete: "My ______ is a man. He is my dad."
questions.context: Juanita, de Ibagué, describe a su papá en su cuaderno de inglés.

options.feedback: Incorrect. "Sister" is a girl in your family, and the sentence talks about a man.
Correct. "Father" means dad, and the sentence says this person is a man and "my dad".
Incorrect. "Mother" is a woman, but the sentence uses "a man" and "He".
Incorrect. "Baby" is a very small child, and the sentence describes a grown man who is the dad.

questions.explanation: Las pistas son "a man" (un hombre) y "He is my dad" (él es mi papá). La palabra en inglés para papá es "father". Por eso la oración completa es "My father is a man. He is my dad."
questions.subject: ingles

questions.statement: Complete: "Lucas is a boy. We have the same mom and dad. Lucas is my ______."
questions.context: Samuel vive en Neiva con sus papás y con Lucas, otro niño que es hijo de los mismos papás.

options.feedback: Incorrect. "Sister" is a girl with your same parents, but Lucas is a boy.
Incorrect. "Mother" is the mom, and Lucas is a boy who shares the mom with the speaker.
Incorrect. "Father" is the dad, but Lucas is a boy with the same dad as the speaker.
Correct. A "brother" is a boy who has the same mom and dad as you, exactly like Lucas.

questions.explanation: Un "brother" es un hermano: un niño que tiene la misma mamá y el mismo papá que tú. El texto dice que Lucas es un niño ("a boy") y que tienen los mismos papás, entonces Lucas es "my brother".
questions.subject: ingles

questions.statement: Tomas shows a photo: "This is my ______. She is a girl and she is ten. We play together."
questions.context: Tomas, de Santa Marta, muestra una foto de vacaciones en la playa a sus compañeros de clase.

options.feedback: Incorrect. "Father" is a man, but the sentence says "She is a girl".
Incorrect. "Brother" is a boy, and the sentence uses "She" and "a girl".
Correct. A "sister" is a girl in your family, and she is ten and plays with Tomas.
Incorrect. A mother is a grown woman, not "a girl" who is ten years old.

questions.explanation: Las pistas son "She" (ella), "a girl" (una niña) y "she is ten" (tiene diez años). Una niña de diez años que juega con Tomas es su hermana, que en inglés se dice "sister". Con "This is my sister" la presentamos.
questions.subject: ingles

questions.statement: Complete: "My mother and my father are my ______."
questions.context: En Popayán, la profesora pide escribir una sola palabra para nombrar juntos a la mamá y al papá.

options.feedback: Incorrect. "Brothers" are boys with your same parents, so this word cannot name your mom and dad.
Incorrect. "Babies" are very young children, but a mother and a father are adults.
Correct. "Parents" is the word for your mother and father together.
Incorrect. "Sisters" are girls in the family, and a father is a man.

questions.explanation: La palabra "parents" significa padres, es decir, la mamá y el papá juntos. Ojo: "parents" no significa "parientes" en español. Se usa en plural porque nombra a dos personas: "mother" + "father" = "parents".
questions.subject: ingles

questions.statement:
Read: "Hi! I'm Daniela. This is my family. My father is Jorge. My mother is Rosa. My brother is Andres."
Who is Rosa?
questions.context: Daniela, una niña de Armenia, escribe un texto corto para presentar a su familia en la clase de inglés.

options.feedback: Correct. The text says "My mother is Rosa", so Rosa is the mother of Daniela.
Incorrect. The text names no sister; Rosa appears after the word "mother".
Incorrect. The father in the text is Jorge, not Rosa.
Incorrect. The brother in the text is Andres, not Rosa.

questions.explanation: Para responder hay que buscar el nombre "Rosa" en el texto. La oración dice "My mother is Rosa" (mi mamá es Rosa). Jorge es el papá y Andres es el hermano. Por eso Rosa es la mamá de Daniela.
questions.subject: ingles

questions.statement:
Read: "There are four people in my family: my father, my mother, my baby sister and me. My baby sister is one year old. She can't walk."
Which sentence is true?
questions.context: Un niño de Valledupar escribe sobre su familia, que acaba de recibir una nueva integrante.

options.feedback: Incorrect. The text says "four people": father, mother, baby sister and the writer, which is 4.
Correct. The text says "my baby sister" and "She", so the baby is a girl.

options.text: The baby is ten years old.
options.feedback: Incorrect. The text says the baby is "one year old", not ten.
Incorrect. The only child named besides the writer is a sister, so no brother appears in the family.

questions.explanation: Hay que comprobar cada oración con el texto. Dice "my baby sister" (mi hermanita bebé) y usa "She" (ella), entonces la bebé es una niña. La familia tiene cuatro personas, la bebé tiene un año y no se menciona ningún hermano.
questions.subject: ingles

questions.statement: Which pair of sentences is correct?
questions.context: En un álbum familiar de Pasto, cada foto lleva dos oraciones en inglés para presentar a un familiar.

options.text: This is my father. She is a teacher.
options.feedback: Incorrect. A father is a man, so we say "He", not "She".

options.text: This is my mother. He is a doctor.
options.feedback: Incorrect. A mother is a woman, so we say "She", not "He".

options.text: This is my brother. She is nine.
options.feedback: Incorrect. A brother is a boy, so the pronoun must be "He", not "She".

options.text: This is my sister. She is seven.
options.feedback: Correct. A sister is a girl, and "She" is the pronoun for a girl, so both sentences agree.

questions.explanation: Después de "This is my ..." usamos "He" (él) para hombres y niños, y "She" (ella) para mujeres y niñas. "Sister" es hermana, así que va con "She". Father y brother van con "He"; mother va con "She".
questions.subject: ingles
